modules.title: Design Thinking for Career Advancement
modules.description: This module introduces the core principles of design thinking and its application to career advancement.

sub_modules.title: Understanding Design Thinking Principles
sub_modules.description: In this sub-module, you will learn about empathy, define, ideate, prototype, and test in the context of design thinking.

activities.title: Design Thinking Overview
activities.description: Watch a video lecture that explains the basics of design thinking.

activities.title: Empathy Exercise
activities.description: Participate in a group discussion to practice empathy and active listening.

sub_modules.title: Design Thinking Tools
sub_modules.description: In this sub-module, you will learn about the design thinking tools used in ideation, prototyping, and testing.

activities.title: Mind Mapping Activity
activities.description: Create a mind map to visualize your ideas using design thinking principles.

activities.title: Prototyping Exercise
activities.description: Participate in pair programming to practice prototyping and testing.

modules.title: Design Thinking Challenges
modules.description: In this module, you will apply design thinking principles to real-world problems and challenges in your career advancement.

sub_modules.title: Career Development Challenge
sub_modules.description: Participate in a group challenge to develop a new skill or industry that aligns with your career goals.

activities.title: Group Brainstorming Session
activities.description: Participate in a group brainstorming session to generate ideas for your career development challenge.

activities.title: Personal Project Development
activities.description: Develop a personal project that demonstrates your application of design thinking principles in your career advancement.

sub_modules.title: Reflect and Improve
sub_modules.description: In this sub-module, you will reflect on your progress and identify areas for improvement in applying design thinking principles to your career advancement.

activities.title: Self-Assessment Exercise
activities.description: Complete a self-assessment exercise to evaluate your progress and identify areas for improvement.

activities.title: Peer Feedback Session
activities.description: Participate in peer feedback to receive constructive feedback from peers on your self-assessment exercise.
